sources.title: Vox Satchurator | AllThePedals
sources.excerpt: The VOX Satchurator is a versatile distortion pedal designed in collaboration with Joe Satriani, delivering his signature tone with features like Gain, Tone, and Volume controls, plus a 'More' gain boost and 'Pad' switch for compatibility. It offers high gain with a musical, dynamic response, suitable for various styles from blues to shred. The Satchurator is designed to be a professional-quality pedal that produces harmonically rich tones. Satchurator compared to ...
